## Code Review Summary
**Mode:** specification · repair pass 7 · candidate `.omp/artifacts/scene-controller-blueprint/spec-canonical-t02-r8.md` (224 lines, read whole; sha binding confirmed via `.omp/plans/execution-state.json`). Cross-checked ticket 02, CONTEXT.md, ticket-01 r5, validator (385 L), tests, blueprint, README, envelope. **Limits:** no shell/git/HA; sha recompute, `git status`, suite execution unrun.

**Findings: 2 LOW (advisory).**

[LOW][spec-text accuracy] Evidence file cannot be the "measured inventory". Loc: §3 D13(4)/(5) L41; §5 AC14(e) L128; §9 item 12 L223. Evidence: D13(5) fixes fields `production_file, measurable, covered, percentage, cases`; no uncovered-line field, yet D13(4)/item 12 call `coverage-evidence-t02.json` the authoritative measured slack inventory. Slack is derivable only as `measurable − covered`. Required change: add `uncovered_lines` to the schema (or reword to "measured slack count").

[LOW][procedural decidability] Step 4 setup ≠ step 5 setup. Loc §6 L150-151. Evidence: step 4 permits "at least TWO different slots"; step 5 fires the second event on "a DIFFERENT button whose slot carries the OTHER" action. Two slots on one button satisfy step 4 but cannot execute step 5. Required change: step 4 should say "on the slots of two different buttons".

### Closures
